tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search Pokémon TCG cards by name. Names are stored in each card's own language (search Korean cards with Korean, e.g. 피카츄; Japanese with ピカチュウ). Filter with lang.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: One card by id (e.g. en-base1-4, ko-sv4a-190) with all of its printings/variants (1st Edition, holo, reverse holo…).

tools.name: list_cards_in_set
tools.description: Every card in a set, ordered by number (e.g. set ja-sv4a, th-sv1v, zh-tw-sv1s).

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: Sets (expansions, promos, decks) for a language, newest first. 14 languages; deepest coverage of Korean, Thai, Indonesian and Chinese.

tools.name: get_set
tools.description: One set by id (e.g. ko-sv4a) with card_count computed from the cards actually present.

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Create a free API key (1,000 requests/month) for an email address. Use this if you don't have a key yet, then pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_api_key" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a free API key (1,000 requests/month) for an email address. Use this if you don't have a key yet, then pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
